verdict.rationale: Restate documents multiple ways to drive the product programmatically: HTTP invocation, typed SDK/ingress clients across languages, a CLI, an Admin API, and an Introspection SQL API, plus per-service OpenAPI 3.1 specs for handlers — all first-party documented and usable by an AI-native/agentic consumer. Missing for 10: no global top-level OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s at common paths) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of API completeness beyond vendor docs.
